name: ai-ux-toolkit
description: AI-assisted skills for UX designers and researchers covering the full workflow — from planning and synthesizing research, through ideation, IA, design, content, accessibility, and prototyping, to validation, developer handoff, and post-launch measurement. 21 plugins / 38 skills, organized by workflow phase. Project-agnostic: every skill references the design system, voice, and conventions of the project it runs in. Includes original skills plus skills vendored from Julian Oczkowski's designer-skills (Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: research-planning
plugins.description: Plan and instrument research with users and stakeholders: choose the method, then draft user interview guides, stakeholder/kickoff interview guides, usability-test scripts, survey questionnaires, and recruiting screeners. Feeds research-synthesis.

plugins.name: ux-research
plugins.description: Synthesize messy qualitative research into themes, evidence-backed insights, and prioritized opportunities — and manage them over time in a tagged, reusable research repository of atomic insights.

plugins.name: competitive-analysis
plugins.description: Live competitive analysis of 3–6 products: real-time browse + comparison matrix, narrative, and opportunities/gaps. Can push findings into a Figma doc page.

plugins.name: synthesis-artifacts
plugins.description: Turn research synthesis into define-phase artifacts: evidence-based personas & JTBD, empathy maps, journey/experience maps, service blueprints, and success-metric definitions (HEART / goal-signal-metric).

plugins.name: design-planning
plugins.description: Define & plan a design: write a brief, get grilled on it, break it into tasks, and orchestrate the full design flow. Vendored from Julian Oczkowski's designer-skills.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Break fixation and run the room: generate a wide, deliberately-spread set of concepts, copy, or IA/layout options, and plan/facilitate collaborative sessions (kickoffs, design sprints, ideation workshops, retros).

plugins.name: prioritization
plugins.description: Decide what to build first: apply a fitting framework (RICE, impact/effort, MoSCoW, value-vs-complexity, Kano) to ideas, features, or fixes and produce a defensible ranked list.

plugins.name: information-architecture
plugins.description: Define the structural layer — navigation, content hierarchy, page structure, URL patterns, and user flows — before visual design. Vendored from Julian Oczkowski's designer-skills.

plugins.name: figma-design-system
plugins.description: Figma + design-system toolkit: design and audit components in Figma, reattach raw frames to the system, and annotate screens for developer handoff.

plugins.name: design-tokens
plugins.description: Generate a design tokens file (CSS variables or Tailwind config): light/dark palettes, spacing scale, type ramp, component-level tokens. Vendored from Julian Oczkowski's designer-skills.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces guided by named aesthetic philosophies. Vendored from Julian Oczkowski's designer-skills.

plugins.name: data-viz
plugins.description: Design clear, accessible charts, dashboards, and data displays: pick the right chart for the question, apply accessible color and labeling, and lay out dashboards that answer questions at a glance.

plugins.name: content-design
plugins.description: Design the words and the states: systematic UI microcopy (errors, empty states, buttons, labels, confirmations) and enumeration of every screen state and edge case a design must cover.

plugins.name: accessibility-heuristics
plugins.description: Design accessibly and check it: proactive inclusive-design guidance up front, plus first-filter audits — WCAG accessibility issues and a Nielsen usability-heuristics evaluation.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Run a structured design critique against the brief and codebase: visual hierarchy, consistency, responsiveness, accessibility, and aesthetic fidelity. Vendored from Julian Oczkowski's designer-skills.

plugins.name: usability-testing
plugins.description: Run usability tests end-to-end with real users: a test plan with tasks and success criteria, moderation guidance, and a findings report with task-level metrics and severity ratings.

plugins.name: rapid-prototyping
plugins.description: Turn a rough idea, brief, or sketch into a clickable, functional prototype — runnable front-end code verified live in the browser preview.

plugins.name: handoff-docs
plugins.description: Draft the documentation that ships a design: component specs, design-system documentation from existing patterns, and agile user stories with acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: brand-voice
plugins.description: Review and rewrite UI copy to match a project's brand voice, using a per-project voice profile loaded at run time.

plugins.name: changelog-automation
plugins.description: Weekly Figma changelog sweep: fingerprint a design-system file, detect drift from a stored baseline, and auto-log changes. Includes the canonical fingerprint algorithm.

plugins.name: product-analytics
plugins.description: Close the loop after launch: plan instrumentation (events, funnels), design and interpret A/B tests/experiments, and read product-outcome data to judge whether the design worked and feed the next round of research.
